method: 2-D pitch-plane multibody (chassis + lumped bogie links carrying the drive wheels and front casters on a pin joint with the bogie spring and stops + lumped rear caster arms on a spring slide), penalty contacts on a full-width terrain, wheel speed PI with the motor torque limit. Planar: left = right, caster swivel offset ignored. CG height, inertia and tyre stiffness assumed.
